full_name: Tony Horwitz | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Tony Horwitz is a nonfiction author, most recently of Blue Latitudes: Boldly Going Where Captain Cook Has Gone Before (Henry Holt, 2002), a historical travelogue around the Pacific in the wake of Captain Cook.
